text:
riley: Dropping the latest UI tweaks for the routing editor. Highlights: new rule-builder card layout, compact priority handles, per-rule inline validation, and a \"Simulate\" pane that returns a step-by-step decision trace. Would love quick UX + a11y eyes before I merge.

tessa: quick look 440. The rule-builder card reads well. A couple things: 1) when rules are collapsed we lose context maybe show condensed conditions summary, 2) prioritize number should be tabbable and announced (aria-label \"priority 1\"), 3) drag affordance needs a 44px hit target on touch.

marco: engineering notes: simulator will call /policies/preview and return an ordered decisions list + ruleRefs. payload example: 

```
{
  "trace": [
    {"step":1, "ruleId":"r-12", "match":true, "action":"route", "meta":"matched header X-Env=beta"},
    {"step":2, "ruleId":"r-5", "match":false}
  ],
  "errors":[],
  "warnings":[{"id":"w1","message":"Overlapping conditions r-12 & r-9","refs":["r-12","r-9"]}]
}
```

marco: UI should link warning.refs to highlight those cards. Also we return suggestions sometimes (e.g. \"suggest splitting by header X\").

tessa: copy nits for validation toast: title first, then short line. Example: \"Overlap detected\" / \"Rules r-12 and r-9 both match GET /api/chat when header X=beta. Click to focus.\" Keep to one sentence.

riley: planned behavior for reorder: optimistic local reorder + unsaved changes state. We show a sticky save bar: \"You have unsaved routing changes\" with Save / Revert. Any objections?

marco: no objections. Backend expects commit payload: { "order": ["r-5","r-12",...] }. If commit fails due to validation we'll return 422 with detail entries referencing ruleId. UI should pin those messages to the save bar and open the validation panel.

_devops-bot_: Deploy note: feature-branch build 0.13.4 includes accessibility lint.

marco: one more thing on the simulator UX: show the decision trace in a small timeline and allow clicking a step to open the matching rule. Also provide a toggle for \"use sample payloads\" vs \"paste request\".

a11y-bot: automated scan: missing aria-live on simulator results region, keyboard focus order ok except when rule cards are collapsed. Contrast ok for primary labels; warning icon color fails 3:1 — recommend using #B04A00 for icon. (report: https://ci.internal/a11y/1759105678)

tessa: thanks @a11y-bot. For non-color signals, add an icon + textual severity label (e.g., ERROR / WARN). Also add a \"Next issue\" button in the validation drawer to focus successive problem rules.

riley: good. Action items: 1) make priority controls focusable + aria-labels, 2) increase drag hit target, 3) add condensed summary for collapsed rule cards, 4) wire simulator trace clicks to rule focus, 5) aria-live for validation + simulator results, 6) explicit save + unsaved bar with undo. I'll update the PR with screenshots and a short screencast of keyboard flow.

marco: I'll return the preview payload and wire up ref links. I'll also make warnings include a severity field.

tessa: ping me when the PR updates, I'll run a final a11y pass. :white_check_mark:

riley: thanks everyone!"
